description.value: Valemount Vacation Inn is one of the largest hotels in Valemount, offering 71 fully renovated rooms ranging from standard doubles to multi-room family suites sleeping up to eight. Situated near Highway 16 in the Robson Valley with mountain views, the property features on-site amenities including a restaurant, sauna, and hot tub. It serves as a practical base for year-round outdoor recreation in the Canadian Rockies, with hiking, rafting, and salmon fishing close by.
